decisions.reason: The FAQ already states that a no-referral mint assigns a Small Block ticket to a random existing NFT holder, and its applicable-draw wording does not exclude those tickets.
The candidate already records random allocation of one Small Block ticket for each no-referral mint, including a same-message update confirming the ticket count.
The source clarification adds no-referral ticket holders to the eligible population and does not change ticket issuance for valid code-used mints.
The source decision does not require a change to the About page, and its applicable Small Block description does not expressly exclude randomly assigned eligible tickets.
The candidate already has a same-message update establishing one randomly assigned $5 commission for every no-referral mint; winner eligibility does not alter commission allocation.
The existing message-672 MODIFY already requires tickets from both code-used and no-code mints to appear on leaderboards and NFT attributes and records the required historical backfill.
The candidate's eligibility window applies to Small Block tickets generally and does not exclude tickets randomly assigned after no-referral mints.
The existing message-672 MODIFY already requires randomly allocated tickets and commissions to be reflected in NFT attributes and records the historical backfill obligation.
The eligible-population clarification concerns randomly assigned no-referral tickets and does not change code-used referral commission behavior.
The existing message-672 MODIFY already captures per-mint commission accounting, no-code projection across required surfaces, backfill, and ticket-commission consistency.
Including randomly assigned ticket holders in winner selection does not change the mint price or revenue allocation.
The source clarification does not necessarily alter the Mission page's high-level description of the Small Block drawing or require new approved copy.
